2403-4681-5170-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

147-653-3967.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-653-3967.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-6972-7606.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Rampant Rejuvenator.
When Rampant Rejuvenator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

240-1753-4247-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2415-6094-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1981-2415-6094-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-6094-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-7061-7737.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Solid Ground
Repeat.

341-2146-2781-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

969-2447-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-2447-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2523-2869-6297.description:
Activate King Darien XLVIII by sacrificing it.
When King Darien XLVIII dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of King Darien XLVIII that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the King Darien XLVIII ability.
Repeat using the King Darien XLVIII token

700-3862-7666.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent has two or more cards in hand.
An opponent controls a creature.
700-3862-7666.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal nonlethal damage to Body of Knowledge after it is donated to an opponent.
700-3862-7666.description:
Donate Body of Knowledge to an opponent that has two or more cards in hand, then deal nonlethal damage to it.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing its controller to draw that many cards.
Orcish Bowmaster triggers for each card drawn. Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Body of Knowledge and causing you to amass Orcs 1.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-6461--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat

457-1409-1419.description:
Activate Breya's Apprentice by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Breya's Apprentice enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Breya's Apprentice
Resolve the Breya's Apprentice trigger, creating an artifact token.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Breya's Apprentice and another artifact, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

222-527-6797-7297.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6797-7297.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3096-3832-6006.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck is empty
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

3536-5078-5741.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

7-4943-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4943-7070.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Lancers en-Kor.
The Lancers en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Lancers en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Hamza.
Repeat.

1636-3143-3949.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one artifact creature token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-3949.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of an artifact creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Kappa Cannoneer trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Kappa Cannoneer trigger, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.

2232-3821-5231-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-3821-5231-6843.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Peregrine Drake.
Repeat.

2167-5626-5721-6754.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-5626-5721-6754.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1247-3918-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1247-3918-4002.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

488-1482-2895-4211-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Jeweled Lotus or Tormod's Crypt must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-1482-2895-4211-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-4289-4359.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2816-3156-4242-4763.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Su-Chi.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Su-Chi, targeting Koll.
When Su-Chi dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Su-Chi by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

804-2533-4681-5231.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat.

147-1223-5231.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
147-1223-5231.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {R}.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.

856-2438-4321-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2438-4321-5477.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 green Plant creature token and a Food artifact token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

678-2060-2606-4017-5256.description:
Cast Pelakka Wurm by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Pelakka Wurm enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain 7 life.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting seven +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability seven times by removing seven +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Pelakka Wurm.
When Pelakka Wurm dies, its second ability and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Pelakka Wurm trigger, causing you to reveal the top card of your library and put it into your graveyard if its a creature card, or draw a card otherwise.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Pelakka Wurm from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Pelakka Wurm's power.
Repeat.

1230-2837-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that can attack this turn.
Your commander is on the battlefield and is a creature.
Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
Your commander does not have summoning sickness.
1230-2837-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and your commander as attackers, attacking the opponent with the highest life total among your opponents or an opponent that is tied for the highest life total among your opponents.
Your commander triggers, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
Once you have infinite Cat tokens, you may instead make Dog tokens using Jinnie Fay or Treasure tokens.

856-1201-1636-4547-4694.notablePrerequisites: Witch's Oven does not have summoning sickness.
856-1201-1636-4547-4694.description:
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Food artifact token.
When the Food enters the battlefield as a creature due to March of the Machines, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food token, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familar enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1263-4050-4556.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {1}.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

3156-3652-4336-4763.notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
3156-3652-4336-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, targeting Ornithopter.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Ornithopter.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Ornithopter, targeting Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Ornithopter dies, Koll triggers, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

250-717-779-3251.description:
Cast Psychic Miasma by paying {1}{B}, discarding Dakmor Salvage and returning Psychic Miasma to your hand.
The Gitrog Monster and Bone Miser's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Gitrog Monster trigger, allowing you to draw a card, but instead replace drawing a card with milling two cards, and returning Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

273-801-4763-5147.description:
Equip Impulsive Pilferer with Shuko.
Sacrifice Impulsive Pilferer to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Impulsive Pilferer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Koll triggers, returning Impulsive Pilferer to you hand.
Sacrifice the Treasure token for {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer.
Repeat.
